notes.title: We have made an update to enable operation by keyboard.
notes.content:
P.S.: The tutorial was temporarily unavailable, so we immediately stopped publishing it and updated it to the corresponding version. We have now completed the correction. We apologize for the inconvenience caused.

Thank you for playing our game.
We are Mikosan Saho Team.
[b]We have made an update to make it keyboard compatible.[/b]

When you want to use the keyboard, go to the Key Configuration from Setting without connecting any controller, and then assign each controller button to any key you like on the keyboard.

We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience we have caused to you.
We hope you will enjoy our game.

notes.title: Regarding to the upcoming update
notes.content:
We are sorry for the inconvenience in regard to the keyboard allocation does not allow you to change the way you want.

For this issue we are working to fix this as soon as possible.
